title: XOR Problem
statement: The task is to construct, for n up to 2·10^5, an array with elements in [0, n] maximizing its length minus the number of zero-XOR subarrays, taking the longest optimal one. Zero-XOR subarrays are pairs of equal prefix XORs, so each of the 2^B prefix values (B = bit length of n) must appear exactly twice (length 2^(B+1)-1), realised by a Gray-code walk whose single-bit steps never exceed n.
